entities.summary: Hengqin Port is a land border checkpoint located in Hengqin, Zhuhai, Guangdong Province, China, connecting mainland China with the Macau Special Administrative Region. Opened on 18 August 2020, it replaces the former Lotus Bridge crossing as the main land port between Zhuhai and Macau in the western area of the territory.
